title: Leverage
description: Lord Ashford has been leaning on our fences in Thornfield through the city watch. Get into his manor, find whatever he keeps in that study, and bring it to me. I want leverage, not justice.

objectives.description: Scout Ashford Manor for guards and a way in
Get past the household to the study, unheard
Find what Ashford is hiding in that study
Hand the letters over to Vex

challenge.description: Manor has guards and locked doors. Being caught alerts the entire household.
challenge.detection_consequences: Quest failure, reputation loss, possible bounty

moral_choice.description: The letters reveal Ashford is trafficking slaves. You can use them for blackmail or expose him publicly.
moral_choice.good_option: Expose Ashford publicly and end the trafficking
moral_choice.neutral_option: Give letters to Guild for blackmail leverage
moral_choice.evil_option: Blackmail Ashford personally for extra gold

notes: Introduces Shadowmaster Vex. Stealth challenge. Ashford Manor in Thornfield. Threat: Ashford's letters prove slave trafficking, and the trafficking itself continues regardless of the quest's outcome. Giver motive: Vex wants leverage against a man leaning on Guild fences, nothing higher-minded. Consequence: the moral_choice block (expose publicly / guild leverage / personal blackmail) is decorative - only obj_report_back is wired, so the description's 'up to you' is not true of the data. A full fix needs three real choice objectives in an OR group at the turn-in.
